review_candidates.title: Executive Assistant to Chief Executive Officer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Key Responsibilities 1. Handle personal and family administration with complete discretion. Support tender and proposal submissions with administrative requirements: company documents, registrations, supplier portals, and submission deadlines. Maintain company licenses, registrations, memberships, and renewal calendars. Build and maintain SOPs, playbooks, templates, and checklists so work can be delegated without the CEO. Maintain an organized, secure filing system for contracts, legal documents
eligibility_evidence: Manage business and personal travel, visas, itineraries, and logistics.
Working knowledge of UAE business administration: licensing, visas, government portals, and vendor processes.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Support tender and proposal submissions with administrative requirements: company documents, registrations, supplier portals, and submission deadlines. Qualifications Demonstrated skills in Executive Administrative Assistance and Executive Support to senior leadership. Proficiency in Administrative Assistance tasks, such as correspondence management and document preparation. Requirements 4+ years as an Executive Assistant, Chief of Staff, Business Operations Coordinator, or similar, with at least 2 years supporting a founder, CEO, or C-level executive.
